prompt: Give tools/compiler/source_tokenizer/Tokenizer.chibi in the Chibi checkout at /Users/cwaldner/Personal/chibi/.worktrees/review-eval/chibi a deep architecture and performance review. Read only; save the review as review.md.
assertions: The review states the input scale (bytes or tokens of real Chibi source) and estimates the per-byte or per-token work, with numbers.
